summary: Pre middleware no longer receives a next() callback; hooks must be async functions or return a promise, where 8.x accepted callback-style pre hooks.
The bundled MongoDB Node.js driver moves from 6.x to 7.x, bringing that driver's own breaking changes.
UUID schema paths hold bson.UUID instances (serialized as hex strings in JSON) instead of Mongoose Buffers that a getter converted to strings.
find(null), findOne(null) and similar calls throw an error instead of ignoring the filter and returning documents.
Passing an aggregation-pipeline array to updateOne()/updateMany()/findOneAndUpdate() throws unless updatePipeline: true is set per query or via mongoose.set(); 8.x sent the pipeline through uncast.
A virtual populate ref function declared on a subdocument schema is called with that subdocument instead of the top-level document.
create() and insertOne() no longer take a generic parameter; the argument must match Partial of the raw doc type (with query-style casting), where 8.x let any value through.
QueryFilter (the first argument of find()/findOne() etc.) types top-level keys from the schema, so wrong value types and unknown operators are TypeScript errors instead of resolving to any.
In TypeScript, this inside default() and required() functions is HydratedDocument and inside validate() is HydratedDocument | Query, replacing the looser previous this type.
The Document class no longer declares an id: any property; id is a string virtual appended to TVirtuals on hydrated documents.
RootQuerySelector, Condition and related filter types are consolidated with the MongoDB driver's filter types instead of Mongoose's own definitions.
SchemaType/Schema doValidate() returns a promise that rejects on a validation error instead of taking a callback, and update validators and save hooks run asynchronously as part of the same change.
bson is no longer a direct dependency of mongoose; BSON types come from mongodb/lib/bson, so code that resolved the bson package through mongoose's dependency tree may no longer find it.
Queries no longer record the stack trace of their first execution (_executionStack) and the skipOriginalStackTraces option that disabled it is removed.
The browser build is removed from the mongoose package; use the separate @mongoosejs/browser package instead.
SchemaType caster, casterConstructor and $embeddedSchemaType are removed; use embeddedSchemaType (the element schema type) and Constructor (the subdocument constructor).
Pluralization rules are corrected and extended (for example model Virus now maps to collection viruses), changing the default collection name for affected model names.
The noListener option is removed from connections and useDb(); passing it throws, and useDb() accepts only { useCache }.
Mongoose no longer sets background: true on indexes by default and Schema.prototype.index() no longer accepts the background option.
isValidObjectId() returns false for numbers and new Types.ObjectId(number) throws, where 8.x returned true and built an ObjectId from the number.
Calling deleteOne() on a subdocument no longer fires its deleteOne hooks immediately; they run only when the parent is saved or deleted so the subdocument is actually removed.
pre/post hooks on custom methods and statics only run when the method is async or returns a promise; callback-style custom methods are no longer hooked.
Document.prototype.updateOne() no longer accepts a callback as its third argument; it only returns a query.
The promiseOrCallback helper export is removed; require('mongoose').promiseOrCallback is undefined.
isAsync middleware (pre('save', true, function(next, done))) is no longer supported; use async functions or return a promise.
The minimum supported Node.js version is 20.19.0; older Node versions that 8.x supported are dropped.
The third argument to Model()/Document() must be an options object; passing a boolean skipId is no longer supported.
Query.use$geoWithin is removed and $geoWithin is never rewritten to $within.
The FilterQuery TypeScript type is renamed to QueryFilter and FilterQuery is no longer exported.
InferRawDocType adds _id: ObjectId to the inferred type, where 8.x inferred only the declared schema fields; InferRawDocTypeWithout_id (added in 9.0.2) restores the old shape.
The new and returnOriginal options of findOneAndUpdate()/findOneAndReplace() are deprecated and print a runtime warning; use returnDocument: 'after' | 'before' (also settable globally).
The 'Duplicate schema index' warning is emitted when indexes are built (createIndexes/syncIndexes/autoIndex) and names the model, instead of when the schema is compiled.
The exported TypeScript types for the long-removed Model.mapReduce() and geoSearch() are removed.
Document.prototype.getChanges() is deprecated in favor of the new $getChanges() alias.
The Document class's _id type parameter defaults to ObjectId instead of unknown, so _id on an un-parameterized Document is typed as ObjectId.
